tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las// rgyun gyi tshogs skong mdor bsdus bzhugs so// 1$0000300gu ru badz+ra bha ra hi na mo na mā mi/

bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi skabs su mchod skong rgyas pa mi lcogs pas tshogs skong dkyus 'gre bya ba dang*/ tshogs brgya gtang ba sogs la khyer bder mos na tshogs kyi dam rdzas su 'os pa ji ltar tshogs pa bshams/ phrin las tshul bzhin btang la bzlas pa dang gtor 'bul yan grub nas/ tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid rdo rje khros ma yi: thugs nas rang byung yi ge ni: raṃ spros me 'bar mi gtsang bsregs: yaṃ spros rlung byung bag chags gtor: khaṃ spros chu byung gnyis 'dzin sbyangs: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal med dbus: oṃ las bde chen ka pā lar: āḥlas ye shes bdud rtsi che: hūm̐ gis 'dod yon cir yang 'char: trāṃ las mchod skong sgrub pa'i rdzas: hrīḥyis zag med bde skyed gyur: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ bh+rūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥs+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: sarba pū dza sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: tshogs mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhengs shig 'og min gnas yul dur khrod nas: khros ma nag mo rigs bzhi'i dhā ki la: zhing sngags lhan skyes mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: dam tshig tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha: chos skyong srung ma gter gyi bdag po kun: dam tshig tshogs kyi 'du bar spyan 'dren na: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis da tshur gshegs: yul snang dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi zhing: thabs shes bza' btung dam tshig rdo rje'i rdzas: 'dod yon bde chen rnam 'gyur thams cad pa: mched lcam ye shes snying por byin phob cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra bha ra hi sarba dhā ki nī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra e h+ye hi: dzñā na ā be sha ya sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ ma hā su kha e ā ral+li ho: tshogs dang pos mchod cing skong ba ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam pa lnga:

rigs lnga yab yum mnyam par sbyor: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bskyil: 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam mang pos: chos dbyings rgyas par gang ba 'dis: bskang ngo mchod do thugs dam bskang: rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs mchog dang: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las: chag nyams 'gal dang ral pa dang: nyams dang 'dres shing bskangs pa sogs: 'phral dang yun gyi sgrib pa kun: gnong 'gyod drag pos mthol bshags na: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: dbyings kyi dgongs pa ma g.yel zhig: 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i 'jug pas ma gtang zhig: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: khros 'khrugs rnam rtog ma mdzad cig: nyams chag thams cad dbyings su bskangs: rtog sgrib bag chags rang sar grol: gzung 'dzin las 'das 'od gsal ngang: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bar pa bshags pa 'bul ba ni/ ho: dgongs shig rdo rje phag mo yum: gzigs shig 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: zhal zas 'dod pa'i yon tan gter: dgyes mchod chen por bzhes su gsol: bdag cag 'khor ba thog med nas: tha ma da ltar thug gi bar: mi shes gti mug dbang du gyur: nyon mongs shugs drag gnyen po chung: bag med dbang gis dam dang 'gal: ma gus bslab pa khyad du bsad: le lo snyom las che ba dang: grogs ngan rkyen gyis gzhan dbang la: brten nas rang bzhin sdig pa dang: bcas pa'i ltung ba char bzhin babs: spyi dang khyad par lhag pa yi: dam las 'gal zhing nyams pa kun: snying nas 'gyod pas mthol lo bshags: phyin chad legs par bsdam lags na: 'gyod bshags dang du bzhes nas kyang: mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces bshags shing yi ge brgya pa mang du bzla'o// tshogs tha ma bsgral mchod bya ba ni/ e yaṃ dz+wa la raṃ: sarba sha trūṃ bigh+nān aṃ ku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje khros ma dbyings nas bzhengs:

'khor gyi mkha' 'gro gzi brjid skyed: las kyi dhā ki bye ba'i tshogs: khros 'khrugs rngams pa'i pho nya spros: 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i dgra: sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs pa'i bgegs: rnal 'byor byang chub bsgrub pa la: bar du gcod pa'i dam sri'i tshogs: khug cig phob cig rten la chings: lha dang phrol la myos su chug: tshe bsod sgrub mchog rnams la stims: rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs: phung po tshogs kyi 'khor lor gtubs: rngams brjid rol pa'i zhal du bzhes: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rnam rtog kun: ka dag chen po'i klong du zlog: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro dhī kā li badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba shā trūn bigh+nān dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: mā ra ya rbad: ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti sarba ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hiḥ zhes bstab bo// slar yang phud gtor 'bul la thugs dam bskang ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dzñā na kā ma gu ṇa s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: zhes pas skong rdzas spel la/ hūm̐ hrī: bskang ngo gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskang: dus gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i thugs= dbyings yum rdo rje phag mo'i thugs= bde chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs= don grub rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs= sgra sgrog pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs= sna tshogs las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs= zhing skyes dpa' bo dpa' mo'i thugs= las mdzad phra men mkha' 'gro'i thugs= gang 'dul dam tshig mkha' 'gro'i thugs= 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs= rgyud gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i thugs= snang srid dag pa rab 'byams thugs= snod bcud rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thugs= nyer spyod kun bzang rol mos thugs= 'dod yon bde chen rgyan gyis thugs= dur khrod gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs= sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs mchog gis thugs= rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsis thugs=

dmar chen rak+ta'i rgya mtshos thugs= rmad byung sha khrag gtor mas thugs= zag med 'dod 'byung tshogs kyis thugs= rang byung 'od gsal zhun mes thugs dam bskang: gzhan yang mchod rdzas skong rdzas sgrub pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: thugs dam gnyan po chos kyi dbyings su bskang: bdag cag dam tshig nyams chag bzod par bzhes: nad rims gdon bgegs mi mthun bar chad sol: tshe bsod dpal 'byor 'khor slob snyan grags spel: rdo rje gsang mchog lam gyi grogs mdzad nas: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol: zhes bskangs shing yig brgya brjod/ tshogs rdzas rnams brda'i 'bul len dang bcas nang gi sreg blug gis rol/ lhag ma bsdus la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: zhes pas byin brlab/ e ā ral+li hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: zhes mgron bkug la/ hūm̐: dbyings dang ye shes gnas yul bdag: las dang dam tshig mkha' 'gro ma: bka' nyan 'jig rten pho nya'i sde: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs rnams kun: phud la dgyes pa phud kyis mchod: lhag la dbang ba lhag mas bskang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: rnam bzhi'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: sarba dhā ki nī ma ma ba liṃ ta khā hi: zhes dang bshal chus mchod/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ ho: bdag cag rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mched lcam gyis: gsang mchog mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i grong khyer du: longs spyod chen pos mchod cing bskangs pa'i mthus: bdag gzhan dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog: ces brjod/ de ni gter gzhung mchod skong las btus pa'o// ༈ //yang tshogs mchod khri 'bum la sogs par de las kyang bsdu bar 'dod na/ thog mar gong smros rgyas pa tshar gcig song nas/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: tshogs kyi nyes skyon ma dag thams cad kun: ye shes me rlung chu yis bsregs gtor bkrus: ban+dha'i snod du dam tshig rdzas kyi bcud: ye shes sprin phung mkha' khyab 'phro bar gyur:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: hūm̐: dbyings nas sku skyod bla ma yi dam lha: rdo rje phag mo mkha' 'gro rab 'byams tshogs: dur khrod ma mo spyang zhon mched sde 'bum: thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya dzaḥdza: hūm̐ hrī: tshogs snod ban+dha chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam: tshogs kyi ngo bo sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga: zag med ye shes rang bzhin lhun por spungs: kun tu dgyes tshim 'od zer rnam par 'phro: bza' bca' btung ba mchog gi dam tshig rdzas: gser gyi ri dang rol mtsho lta bur bskyil: thugs dam gnyan skong 'dod yon bsam mi khyab: gling bzhi mu khyud khor yug brdal ba 'di: bla ma yi dam tshogs la mchod par 'bul: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro rab 'byams dgyes par bzhes: chos srung dam can mnyes pa'i phul gyur nas: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub char ltar phob: byang chub sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang: mchog dang thun mong phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ badz+ra bha ra hi kro dhī kā li badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma dhā ki nī maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: ma bh+yo dzaḥs pa ri bā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes gter gzhung phrin las kyi gtor 'bul kha bsgyur ba dang lhag ma smon lam gong ltar byas pas 'grub bo// 'di la nongs pa mchis na rtsa ba gsum la bshags shing dge bas rdo rje btsun mos rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang nye bar mkho ba'i yan lag tu pad+ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang chen por bris pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga laṃ/// /
